items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: well, there was two more, there was Raymond Winfield and Walter Beaty, you know.

ctx.x: And then later we will get back into all the dancers that you met through your career and their particular styles. And also how they influenced you and the change of their styles through the years.
Yes. Well, there were only two that inspired me, and that was J. D. -- which I called "Slim" Chuckles, and John Bubbles of Buck and Bubbles, you see.
All the other dancers you didn't find that --
